# skret

> Cloud-provider secret manager CLI wrapper with Doppler/Infisical-grade developer experience. Secrets live in your own cloud account (AWS SSM Parameter Store, GCP Secret Manager, and OCI Vault today, local YAML for dev/test) under IAM policies you already manage — no SaaS control plane, no new billing line.

## Getting started

- [Getting Started](https://skret.n24q02m.com/guide/getting-started/): Install skret and run the two-command loop (`skret setup` then `skret run -- <command>`); covers `skret init`, `get`/`set`/`list`/`import` basics.
- [Installation](https://skret.n24q02m.com/guide/installation/): Homebrew, Scoop, Go install, and verified binaries.
- [Verifying a release](https://skret.n24q02m.com/guide/verify-release/): Check a release by hand: the keyless Cosign signature on `checksums.txt` (exact certificate identity and OIDC issuer), SLSA build provenance with `gh attestation verify`, and the SPDX JSON SBOM next to each archive.
- [Configuration](https://skret.n24q02m.com/guide/configuration/): The `.skret.yaml` schema — environments, providers, required secrets, and the global `--config <path>` flag to bypass directory discovery (multi-namespace processes).
- [Authentication](https://skret.n24q02m.com/guide/authentication/): `skret auth login/status/logout`, AWS SSO, OIDC, and IAM setup.
- [Bootstrap](https://skret.n24q02m.com/guide/bootstrap/): `skret bootstrap` provisions a dedicated least-privilege IAM user + access key from an admin identity, used once.

## Scripts and agents

- [Using skret from a script or agent](https://skret.n24q02m.com/guide/agents/): Exit codes (`ExitLeakFound`=10, `ExitDrift`=9, ...), the `--format json` error envelope (`{"error","code","remediation"}`) any command can opt into on failure, non-interactive flags (`get --plain`, `env --format=json`, `set --from-stdin`), `--format json` on the write path (`set`/`delete`/`history`/`sync`, alongside the existing `get`/`list`/`env`/`diff`/`scan`), and recipes for `run`/`get`/`env`/`set`/`sync`/`scan`/`import` in CI/cron/AI agents. `skret delete` and `skret rollback` are the only commands that prompt (y/N) without `--confirm`/`-f`. `skret history`/`skret rollback` are experimental, gated behind `SKRET_EXPERIMENTAL=1`.
- [MCP server (skret mcp)](https://skret.n24q02m.com/guide/mcp/): stdio and Streamable HTTP MCP server exposing `skret_list` (names only), `skret_get` (values), `skret_env`, `skret_status`/`skret_doctor`; write tools (`skret_set`/`skret_delete`/`skret_rotate`) gated behind `mcp.allow_write` (default off) plus a per-call `confirm: true` argument, with the optional `mcp.allowed_envs`, `mcp.allowed_tools` and `mcp.allowed_keys`/`mcp.denied_keys` (`path.Match` globs, denied wins) filters; one JSON session audit record per tool call on stderr (optionally also `mcp.audit_log`), secret values redacted from every error and diagnostic; MCP protocol `2026-07-28` (stateless, `server/discover`) alongside `2025-06-18`/`2025-03-26`/`2024-11-05`; local-provider reads audited as `mcp_read` entries. Claude Code / OMP wiring snippets included.
- [Value fidelity](https://skret.n24q02m.com/guide/value-fidelity/): How skret preserves secret values byte-for-byte across `get`/`env`/`set`/`template`/`sync`/`import`, and the one exception (`skret run` sanitizes control bytes for the process environment).
- [Error Codes](https://skret.n24q02m.com/reference/error-codes/): Full exit-code table with remediation steps per code.

## Command guides

- [Sync](https://skret.n24q02m.com/guide/sync/): Push secrets to GitHub Actions, Cloudflare Worker/Pages, or a dotenv file; `--dry-run` to preview with no writes, `--no-overwrite` (or per-target `no_overwrite`) to only fill missing keys, `--skip-unchanged` for drift-aware CI syncs, `--prune` (github) to delete target secrets no source key produces (refuses an empty source and a declared target without `sources`); per-target `sources` (path + `keys`/`exclude`) to sync and prune against the union of several paths.
- [Scan](https://skret.n24q02m.com/guide/scan/): Leak-guard — find managed secret values committed into tracked files; exits 10 on a match, wire into pre-commit or CI.
- [Protect](https://skret.n24q02m.com/guide/protect/): `skret protect` blocks staged `.env` files and well-known plaintext credential formats with no `.skret.yaml` or provider; exits 10 on a finding and prints file, line and rule, never the value. Published as the `skret-protect` (golang) and `skret-protect-system` (system) pre-commit hooks; `--allow` and `skret:allow` for intentional fixtures.
- [Redacted output](https://skret.n24q02m.com/guide/redact/): `skret run --redact` masks injected secret values (raw, multi-line, base64, URL-encoded) and token-shaped strings in the child's stdout and stderr as `[REDACTED]`, preserving the exit code; the child's stdout and stderr become pipes, not a TTY.
- [Diff](https://skret.n24q02m.com/guide/diff/): Compare two secret sets without printing values; `--exit-code` turns it into a CI drift gate.
- [Template](https://skret.n24q02m.com/guide/template/): Render `${KEY}` placeholders in a file from secret values.
- [Hub](https://skret.n24q02m.com/guide/hub/): Publish a names-only secret inventory (no values) to a dashboard.
- [Watch mode](https://skret.n24q02m.com/guide/watch/): Auto-restart `skret run` when a secret changes upstream, with no polling cost.
- [Browse](https://skret.n24q02m.com/guide/browse/): Interactive terminal UI to browse and reveal secrets on demand.
- [Completion](https://skret.n24q02m.com/guide/completion/): Shell completions (bash/zsh/fish/PowerShell) for `get`/`delete`/`history`/`rollback`, including real secret key names via a names-only listing (no decryption cost).

## Providers

- [Provider Comparison](https://skret.n24q02m.com/providers/comparison/): Cost and feature ranking across AWS SSM, OCI Vault, Azure Key Vault, GCP Secret Manager, AWS Secrets Manager.
- [GCP Secret Manager](https://skret.n24q02m.com/providers/gcp/): Setup, ADC authentication, minimum IAM roles, provider-specific notes.
- [AWS SSM Parameter Store](https://skret.n24q02m.com/providers/aws/): Setup, minimum IAM policy, provider-specific notes.
- [OCI Vault](https://skret.n24q02m.com/providers/oci/): Setup, minimum IAM policy, provider-specific notes.
- [Azure Key Vault](https://skret.n24q02m.com/providers/azure/): Setup, DefaultAzureCredential auth, secret-naming sanitization, versioning notes.
- [Local YAML Provider](https://skret.n24q02m.com/providers/local/): Dev/test-only provider backed by a plain YAML file.
